verdict.rationale: The README shows the CLI pulling a model straight from Hugging Face by repo name (`llama cli -hf ggml-org/Qwen3.5-0.8B-GGUF`), and the same works for `llama serve`. That is first-party command-line model download, though the evidence only shows it as a flag example. Nothing in the pack shows searching for models or managing local ones (listing, removing, updating). Missing for 10: model search from the CLI, local model management commands, explicit documentation of the download/caching behavior, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search, download, and manage models from a command-line interface
